changes.description: [V3] Support for MCP elicitation, so MCP tools can ask you for input through a form or a link
[V3] Type suggested changes directly into a workflow plan approval
[V3] Delete memories you no longer want from `/memories`
`/model edit` hides models you do not use from the `/model` picker
[V3] Workflow use under Features in `/settings` to choose when Kiro starts workflows on its own
[V3] `--trust-workspace` skips the workspace trust prompt for one launch without saving the decision
[V3] Tool approvals list Allow once and Deny once first, then the options that create an allow or deny rule
[V3] The session dashboard asks `Do you want to delete …?` before deleting a session
[V3] Shell commands Kiro cannot parse are denied automatically instead of prompting you to approve them
[V3] Subagents no longer get the MCP servers declared inline in their parent agent
Show `Working...` when the agent goes quiet while preparing a tool call instead of a frozen screen
[V3] Headless mode no longer answers the agent's questions or approves requests that name no trusted tool
[V3] Headless mode reuses MCP sign-ins saved by interactive sessions
[V3] `/sessions` opens and scrolls without freezing when you have many saved sessions
Enterprise overage status and consumed credits are visible in `/usage`
[V3] Workflows pick up where they left off after a restart, without replanning or repeating steps
A refusal partway through a reply now continues on the fallback model instead of starting over
With `chat.allowIcons` off, the TUI drops box drawing and block characters, and arrow keys read as words
Mermaid diagrams in chat render correctly in more cases instead of showing raw HTML or failing
[V3] Deny rules save at the scope you pick, and a call a rule blocks is no longer reported as cancelled
[V3] `/rewind` to a failed or unfinished turn now forks at the right point
[V3] Tool approvals in the workflow monitor open on the current call and close with `q`
[V3] `kiro-cli acp` no longer shuts down unexpectedly while the agent is still running
Pasted images, and pasted or dictated text in menu and picker filters, now work as expected
[V3] Switching agents with `/agent` now loads the skills declared by the agent you switch to
[V3] `ssh` and `ssh-keygen` no longer fail with `No user exists for uid` in the macOS sandbox
[V3] Deleting files outside the workspace folders no longer fails on Windows
[V3] Remote MCP servers over HTTP now follow only same-origin redirects
[V3] When Workflows are enabled, a workflow now starts only when you explicitly ask for one
`/tools` lists each tool with one labelled line per field when the screen reader setting is on, so screen readers announce Source, Status and Description
`kiro-cli mcp add --agent` now grants the new server to agents whose `tools` list lacks it, and upgrades the agent file for V3 when `chat.enableAutoAgentUpgrade` is on
[V3] Resuming a V2 session now tells you its saved tool approvals weren't carried over and how to keep approvals in V3
[V3] Compaction retries without images when the model rejects history images
[V3] MCP sign-in no longer leaves a pinned OAuth callback port occupied afterward
[V3] Unavailable optional power MCP servers no longer block prompt turns
[V3] Long image sessions omit older images to stay within the request limit
[V3] Workflow plan approvals open with the first offered option highlighted, so Enter selects it
HTML doctypes and tag brackets in code previews use theme colors with readable contrast
[V3] Custom agents running as subagents can search their own knowledge bases
[V3] MCP servers added from the registry launch the catalog's package version again
[V3] Messages sent after a spec task run can keep updating its tasks
[V3] Agents that use `@builtin` now include web search, as in V2
[V3] Dispatched subagents now load their own skills instead of the parent agent's skills
[V3] User agents keep their file allow and deny rules when a session starts in the home folder
